services.name: Cold Plunge
services.desc: Revive & Thrive is a modern wellness studio offering traditional therapies such as sauna, cold plunge, sensory deprivation, salt therapy, and normatech compression. When we enter the cold plunge, our body begins to cool itself dramatically, causing a decrease in our core body temperature. This causes a constriction in our blood flow throughout the body. We are forced to breathe deeply to adapt to the stress of the temperature change. When we exit the cold plunge, our body must then return to its normal temperature, causing an increase in blood and oxygen flow throughout the body. services.name: Float Therapy
services.desc: Revive & Thrive is a modern wellness studio offering traditional therapies such as sauna, cold plunge, sensory deprivation, salt therapy, and normatech compression. We live in a sensory world, from the minute we wake up until the moment we go to sleep. Even a master meditator can feel the weight of gravity or the temperature of the air on the skin. What if we had time where we could be totally sensory deprived, left only with our own consciousness? In our Sensory Deprivation Suite, also known as a Float Suite, you get to experience just that.
